facts.statement: The genus Magwayodus was named by Adnet and colleagues.
Magwayodus lived during the Priabonian stage of the Eocene epoch.
The type locality of Magwayodus is the Yaw Formation in Myanmar.
facts.quote:
Type locality: Yaw Formation
Country: Myanmar
